notes.title: Misc Fixes
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, a little update just went live:
[list]
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue with Gun Timeout not activating while playing the game one Xbox One / Xbox 360 controller
[*] Stopped Vicious Red Hole from spawning on final waves of level 2 and level 4 (prevents potential framerate drop caused by win / defeat screen clashing)
[/list]
Cheers
